how: Drive the live page over CDP: Network.setCookie injects the flow's httpOnly draft (written by POST /assessment/new/who then /assessment/new/mode), the page is opened, one row is opened and saved, one row is dragged by its handle, and every state is read back from the DOM -- after a full reload for the persisted order, and again at 390px. A screenshot cannot see a gesture; these are the counts and the order.
